messages:
Marta Kovacs: Hi @people-ops — quick one. We just had an adoption placement (agency letter attached) with placement date 2033-11-02. I live in Hungary now but the adoption agency and some paperwork reference US tax/benefits. Will Redwood19s adoption leave/top-up apply to international employees and how are stipends/reimbursements taxed? Also need to move my leave start to 2033-10-30 so I can attend placement prep.

Renee (People Ops): Huge congrats, Marta! :tada: Short answer: we support adoptive leave for international employees, but tax/treatment varies by country. For Hungary specifically we authorize the standard adoption top-up for primary caregivers, but Payroll/Legal will confirm withholding. Please upload the placement letter to the secure form and choose "adoption/foster placement" so we can start the workflow.

Marta Kovacs: Uploaded file `adopt-2033-11` and selected Hungary in the form. Also signed the PHI/consent link when it popped.

HR Forms Bot: Auto-confirmation: submission `adopt-2033-11` attached to case PO-2033-412. Consent received. People Ops will respond within 24 hours.

Anika (Legal): Hi Marta  congrats! For international adoptions we need to separate two things: 1) employment protections (company policy + local labor law) and 2) tax/treatment of any company-paid top-ups or stipends. In Hungary, employer-paid top-ups are usually taxable income; reimbursements for placement counseling can be arranged as expense reimbursements (require receipts) which may have different treatment. We'll confirm exact withholding with Payroll.

Luis (Payroll): Thanks Anika. Marta, FYI payroll cutoff note: if People Ops approves the date change and top-up before 2033-10-25 we can reflect pay in the 2033-10-31 run; otherwise it will appear the next cycle. For cross-border payroll we may need a tax-residency declaration — please DM me your current address and any recent tax IDs. Retro adjustments possible but limited to one payroll run back.

Renee (People Ops): Noted. We can also provide a small placement counseling stipend (policy covers up to A�200) as a reimbursement. If you want that, file the reimbursement form after you incur the expense and attach receipts. We'll mark your device checkout for hold until two weeks after return if you need it.

Marta Kovacs: Thanks  I will DM address and tax ID to Luis. I'd like the counseling stipend option  will save receipts. Also please change leave start to 2033-10-30.

Bogdan (Eng): Marta all good on our side. I can cover oncall for the two-week prep period and we'll reassign any sprint tickets. Leave a 1-page handover in the repo and we're set.

Renee (People Ops): Action items: 1) record provisional leave start 2033-10-30; 2) queue payroll for country-specific tax check and withholding instructions; 3) confirm adoption top-up eligibility (company policy) and counseling stipend routing; 4) place asset hold on request; 5) schedule 15-min sync with Marta + Bogdan to confirm handover. We'll finalize once Luis confirms payroll treatment.

Luis (Payroll): Marta once I get your tax/residency info I'll confirm withholding and the payroll cutoff. If anything needs manual coding for cross-border top-up I'll follow up in thread.

Marta Kovacs: Really appreciate the quick answers and help coordinating this. Thank you all. :pray:
